Newks Menu: Fresh and Delicious Options for Every Craving

Welcome to Newks, a restaurant known for its fresh ingredients, unique flavors, and a vast selection of deli-inspired dishes. Whether you’re planning to dine in or order your meal online for takeout, Newks has something to satisfy every craving. In this guide, we will explore the complete Newks menu, featuring pricing details, delivery options, and catering services for large gatherings. So, whether you’re a fan of mixed greens, crave all-natural chicken, or want to try their famous scratch-made chicken salad made with grapes, this detailed menu guide will help you discover everything Newks has to offer.

Newks Delivery Menu and Online Ordering

Newks makes it incredibly convenient for its customers by offering a delivery menu that is available for takeout and delivery. You can now order your meal online and have it delivered to your door or pick it up at a location near you. Newks has partnered with popular food delivery apps to make the experience as smooth as possible.

Menu Category Description Price
Salad Bowls Freshly made salads with various topping options Starting at $7.99
Signature Sandwiches Served on freshly baked Parisian bread Starting at $8.99
Artisan Pizzas Hand-tossed pizzas with premium toppings Starting at $9.99
Soups Daily soups made with scratch ingredients Starting at $5.99
Mac & Cheese Elbow pasta with cheddar and Swiss cheeses $4.99
Desserts Freshly made sweet treats like brownies and cakes $2.99

Ordering online for takeout is easy—simply visit Newks’ official website or mobile app, select your meal, and enjoy the quick and convenient service. The Newks delivery menu offers the same fresh food options, ensuring that your meal arrives in perfect condition, whether for lunch, dinner, or an office catering event.

 Newks Catering Menu for Special Events

Whether you’re hosting a small gathering or need food for a corporate event, the Newks catering menu provides a range of delicious options. From fresh salads to signature sandwiches, pizzas, and desserts, Newks can cater to any occasion. You can even order online for takeout and have your catering delivered directly to your office or event venue.

Catering Item Description Price (per person)
Salad Bar Customizable salads with toppings $9.99
Sandwich Platter Assortment of freshly made sandwiches $10.99
Pizza Party Pack Includes a variety of artisan pizzas $12.99
Soup & Salad Combo Fresh soups served with mixed green salads $8.99
Desserts Platter Assortment of cookies, brownies, and cakes $5.99

Newks also offers office catering, ensuring your meeting or corporate event is fueled with fresh, flavorful meals. All catering options include delivery, and you can customize your menu with options like salads made from mixed greens, sandwiches, and more.

 Explore Newks Salad Bowls: Fresh and Flavorful

Newks is well-known for its salads, made with mixed greens, fresh vegetables, and premium proteins like all-natural chicken. Each salad is made to order and can be customized with toppings like red onion, feta, cucumber, and artichoke hearts. Here’s a look at some of Newks’ most popular salad options:

Salad Description Price
Caesar Salad Fresh romaine, parmesan, croutons, and Caesar dressing $7.99
Greek Salad Mixed greens, feta, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, cucumbers $8.49
Chef’s Salad Mixed greens, all-natural chicken, cheddar, tomatoes, croutons $9.49
Southern Salad Scratch-made chicken salad made with grapes, pecans, red onion $10.99

All salads are served with your choice of dressing, including lemon basil vinaigrette, Greek dressing, honey mustard, and sherry vinaigrette. You can also add proteins like grilled all-natural chicken or seasoned shrimp for an additional charge.

 Newks Specialty Sandwiches and Signature Soups

In addition to salads, Newks offers a wide selection of signature sandwiches that feature top-quality ingredients like chicken bacon, pimiento cheese, and provolone cheese. Served on Parisian bread, these sandwiches are perfect for a satisfying meal.

Sandwich Description Price
Chicken Bacon Club Grilled chicken, bacon, Swiss cheese, lettuce, and tomatoes $9.99
Pimiento Cheese Sandwich Scratch-made pimiento cheese on fresh Parisian bread $8.99
Turkey Avocado Sandwich Turkey breast, avocado, lettuce, and mayo $9.99
Newks Club Turkey, ham, bacon, cheddar, and Swiss with Creole mustard $10.49

You can pair your sandwich with a cup of soup, with options like tomato basil and loaded potato soup. Newks soups are made from scratch with high-quality ingredients like chicken broth, onions, garlic, and freshly diced vegetables.

 Newks Pizzas: Artisan Pies Made to Order

For pizza lovers, Newks offers a selection of artisan pizzas made with hand-tossed dough and high-quality ingredients like pepperoni, mozzarella, and pizza sauce. Each pizza can be customized with extra toppings like artichoke hearts, basil pesto, and red pepper flakes.

Pizza Description Price
Margherita Pizza Mozzarella, tomatoes, basil, and olive oil $9.99
BBQ Chicken Pizza Chicken, BBQ sauce, red onions, cilantro $10.49
Pepperoni Pizza Classic pepperoni and mozzarella $9.49
Veggie Pizza Artichokes, mushrooms, red onion, bell peppers $10.49

Each pizza is topped with fresh ingredients and served with your choice of sides. The combination of flavors, including the five cheese mac, signature white BBQ sauce, and aged yellow cheddar, makes Newks’ pizzas a must-try.

 Newks Mac & Cheese and Pizzoli: A Cheesy Delight

Newks is known for its creamy Mac & Cheese, made with elbow pasta and a blend of yellow and Vermont white cheddar cheeses. This cheesy delight is a favorite among kids and adults alike, offering a comforting meal that’s perfect for lunch or dinner.

Mac & Cheese Description Price
Classic Mac & Cheese Elbow pasta with yellow and Vermont white cheddar $4.99
Five Cheese Mac A blend of five cheeses folded into elbow pasta $5.99
Chicken Bacon Mac Chicken, bacon, cheddar, and parmesan $6.49

Newks also offers Pizzoli, a delicious stuffed pizza crust filled with cheese, pepperoni, and other toppings. Perfect for pizza lovers looking for something new, this dish is baked to perfection and served hot.

Desserts and Sweet Treats at Newks

No meal is complete without dessert, and Newks delivers with freshly made sweets like brownies, cookies, and cakes. These treats are the perfect way to end your meal.

Dessert Description Price
Newks Signature Brownie Rich chocolate brownie with walnuts $2.99
Fresh-Baked Cookies Chocolate chip, oatmeal raisin, and more $1.99
Lemon Cake Zesty lemon cake with a sweet glaze $3.99

 Newks Catering Menu: Feed a Crowd

If you’re planning a party or corporate event, Newks has a wide range of catering options. The Newks catering menu features sandwiches, salads, pizzas, and desserts that are perfect for feeding large groups. You can order online for takeout and fast delivery, ensuring that your event is well-fed with Newks’ signature flavors.

Catering Item Description Price (per person)
Salad Bar Fresh mixed greens, toppings, and dressings $9.99
Sandwich Platter An assortment of fresh sandwiches $10.99
Pizza Pack A variety of artisan pizzas $12.99
Dessert Platter Assortment of cookies, brownies, and cakes $5.99

With Newks delivery menu options, you can get fresh, delicious meals delivered to your office or event venue. Newks eatery catering ensures that all your guests leave satisfied.

Conclusion

Whether you’re dining in, ordering online, or catering an event, Newks has something for everyone. From mixed greens salads to artisan pizzas, and mac & cheese, the Newks menu offers a wide range of fresh, delicious options that cater to all tastes. Visit Newks eatery today to view Newks menu and order online for takeout or delivery.
